description: Drainage Lines Joondalup is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Joondalup. This dataset details the location and attributes of drainage lines throughout the City of Joondalup. Coverage: City of Joondalup. The portal files it under the publisher City of Joondalup. Its tags are Joondalup, drainage, infrastructure. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-11-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
